messages:
Olivia: Heads-up — reseller Apex flagged a legacy pricing stack that applied old promo tiers to their merchant customers for Jan–Mar. They want a retro rebate.
Maya: Ugh, saw that in the reconciliation report this morning. How big is the hit?
Olivia: Apex sent a CSV. Quick calc shows $12,450 total across 18 merchants after proration. Attached: small sample lines they pasted.
Olivia: `invoice_id,merchant,period,charged,should_have,delta
inv-9981,MerchantCo,2025-02,$1,050,$750,$300`
Raj: Do we have a reseller agreement clause that limits retro credits? If not, we should treat as goodwill for retention.
Maya: Agreement has a 30-day pricing audit window, but this was an onboarding promo misflag that lasted ~10 weeks — legal says it's on us.
Sam: Payment ops: manual refunds vs credit memo? For 18 merchants it's messy to refund individually. We can issue a single Apex rebate credit and let them distribute. Need approval and GL code.
Dana: OK — I approve a consolidated rebate to Apex as a partner-level credit. Amount approved: $12,450. Please use GL code `GL-REV-RETRO` and memo: "Apex reseller legacy promo retro rebate Jan–Mar 2025".
finance-bot: Created ticket FIN-4982 for manual credit memo workflow. Approver: Dana. Status: pending posting. Link: https://redwood.internal/fin/tickets/FIN-4982
Maya: Thanks Dana. Sam — can you confirm cashflow impact and whether we need CFO sign-off given >$10k?
Sam: CFO notified via email; she said operational sign-off from finance suffice for this amount but wants a one-line note on the month-end commentary. I'll schedule the credit posting for 2025-03-31 EOD to match accruals.
Raj: Also confirm Apex will apply the consolidated credit to merchants. Request a signed ack from Apex (one-pager) before posting.
Olivia: I'll ping Apex legal now and ask for the ack doc.
Maya: For bookkeeping, tag the credit as "Partner Rebates — Corrective" in the memo and attach the CSV.
finance-bot: FIN-4982 updated: attachments required: CSV sample, Apex ack PDF, approval thread link.
Sam: I'll prepare the credit memo, post once ack is in place. ETA: tomorrow morning.
Olivia: Apex replied: "Ack received — will accept consolidated credit and distribute per our channel agreement. See attached signed PDF." They also asked for invoice reference `inv-ALL-Apex-2025retro`.
Dana: Great — proceed. Sam please include their invoice ref in the memo.
Maya: Noted. After posting, please update the reconciliation sheet so Q1 metrics reflect the rebate.
Sam: Will do and confirm here when posted. :white_check_mark:
Olivia: Thanks team. One follow-up: can we add an alert rule to flag promo-tier mismatches during onboarding? Preventive ask for product/eng later.
Raj: Good idea. I'll loop in product.
